thread:
maria: Heads up — found a glibc CVE in the slim base layer (CVE-2025-3456). Need coordinated rebuild + signed cutover. Anyone able to join a quick sync? :warning:
lee: On it. Do we have a patched distro? Can we pin to slim-base:2025.03?
samir: Affected services: runtime-prod, batch-workers. Recommend staging canary first, 2% prod rollout after quick smoke.
andrea: Audit question — can we tie registry pulls to the old digest in audit logs? Need registry -> splunk pipeline enabled for the window.
jason: Plan: rebuild, sign with KMS-backed cosign key, push, canary deploy. Post-scan before prod.
maria: Draft runbook (short):
1) fork image branch and rebuild minimal layers
2) run vuln scans (grype + internal)
3) sign image with KMS-backed cosign key
4) push canary tag + attest
5) canary deploy (staging then 2% prod)
6) monitor latency/error + audit logs; rollback if anomalies
lee: Quick commands to prototype: 
```
bazel build //images/slim-base:latest
cosign sign --kms gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign 
gcloud container images add-tag gcr.io/redwood/slim-base:2025.03 gcr.io/redwood/slim-base:canary
```
samir: RBAC note — build service account needs roles/cloudkms.signer and Artifact Registry write. @security please confirm least-privilege binding.
andrea: Also: enable admin audit logs for artifactregistry.googleapis.com and containerregistry.googleapis.com for 90d (compliance check).
security-bot: Automated triage created INC-2025-0042 for CVE-2025-3456. Assigned: samir. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2025-0042
maria: Proposed cutover window: Friday 2025-03-14 21:00 UTC. If blockers, push to Monday morning. Objections?
jason: Fine. I'll prep cosign rotation doc + preflight checklist. Will include commands for KMS key usage and cosign verification.
lee: Ops ask: can we pre-warm dedicated GPU/pool for canary to avoid cold-start sprawl? Noted increased pull traffic during canary.
andrea: Compliance: confirm that cosign signature envelope ID is logged to audit so we can trace which key signed which image. Also record the signature ID in the release ticket.
samir: Fallback policy (if canary shows regressions): update routing to stable signed image and scale canary down. Short-runbook: 
```
# fallback
1) update routing policy to prefer gcr.io/redwood/slim-base:stable
2) scale canary -> 0
3) collect failing traces and isolate bad layer
```
maria: After push, run grype + internal smoke tests. Post results here and mark INC as in-progress. :white_check_mark:
jason: Checklist uploaded: https://go/redwood/image-rebuild-checklist (includes RBAC, cosign, audit steps)
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy at 2025-03-14T21:00:00Z by jason
andrea: Tagging @compliance for retention approval.
compliance: Approved 90d retention for this rebuild window. :thumbsup:
maria: Great — I'll publish a 1hr preflight message and a 10min heads-up before the window. If anyone wants to run the preflight earlier ping me in DM.
lee: I'll open the IAM PR for the signer role and link it here.
samir: I'll run a targeted grype run on the rebuilt image once available and post the report.
andrea: Also: enable audit forwarding for the exact time window to long-term archive (S3/GCS) and snapshot signature meta.
maria: Thanks team — keep updates short; anyone with blockers call out and we'll triage in the incident channel.
